name: Dark Parts
source:
You’ve feared the dark since childhood, and now night terrors have returned. Power outages strike, and strange notes slip under your door.

Who will you turn to? Your devoted best friend? The quiet stranger who oddly comforts you? Or will you face the darkness alone?

[From [url=https://memorious.itch.io/dark-parts]Itch.io[/url]]
